messages.subject: Logging in user programatically.
parts:
I'm currently building a signup flow for my shiny application.  I'm able to add a new user in R through LDAP, but I really would like the application to automatically login the user to the application then redirect them to the authenticated site. Is there a way to login a user without presenting a login screen?

Thank you,
Evan
